about.title: About Me
about.bio1: I am Eduardo Levy, a back-end developer and technology enthusiast, passionate about solving complex problems and turning them into practical and efficient solutions. I focus on web development and interactive applications.
about.bio2: I have experience with various tools and frameworks, such as Django, Python, Vue3, Quasar, Flask, FastAPI, and Node.js. I use PostgreSQL, MySQL, and MongoDB to manage databases efficiently. I have knowledge in Git, Docker, and CI/CD for agile and reliable deliveries.
about.backend_desc: I build robust and scalable systems using technologies like Django, FastAPI, and Flask.
about.frontend_desc: I create dynamic and interactive interfaces using Vue3, Quasar, and responsive design best practices.
about.apis_desc: I develop RESTful and GraphQL APIs with a focus on performance and security.
about.data_desc: I organize and optimize relational and non-relational databases for modern applications.
